title: Unique Charred Italian Barramundi Ossobuco
description: A weeknight Italian dish featuring charred barramundi, confit tomato, and a no onion no garlic friendly ossobuco style, served from a fondue pot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the barramundi fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the fondue pot over medium high heat.
Sear the barramundi fillets until charred on both sides, about 2 minutes per side.
Transfer the fondue pot to the preheated oven and bake for 8 minutes.
While the fish is cooking, heat the white wine in a saucepan over medium heat until reduced by half.
Stir in the confit tomatoes, lemon juice, and chopped parsley.
Remove the fondue pot from the oven and place it over low heat on the stovetop.
Add the reduced white wine and confit tomato mixture to the fondue pot.
Simmer the sauce for 2 minutes, then stir in the grated parmesan.
